<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Mirage](/Spells.aspx?ID=1604)
<actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 344

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 10 minutes

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 500 feet

**Area** 50-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until your next daily preparations
</row>

</column>

---

You create an illusion that causes natural terrain to look, sound, feel, and smell like a different kind of terrain. This doesn't disguise any structures or creatures in the area.

 Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

---
**Heightened (5th)** Your image can also disguise structures or create illusory structures (but still doesn't disguise creatures).
name: Mirage
